name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Watermelon Z
description:
Juicy, refreshing, and smooth. The Mad Labs Watermelon Z disposable brings a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Watermelon Z serves up ripe, sweet watermelon flavor with a crisp, refreshing finish — a bright, summery taste that stays smooth pull after pull. Backed by that signature "Z" (Zkittlez) influence, it pairs candy-sweet fruitiness with an easygoing, balanced feel. The effect leans relaxed and mellow with a gentle mood lift, making it a versatile pick for kicking back any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Watermelon Z flavor — sweet, ripe watermelon with a crisp, refreshing finish
Relaxed, balanced effects — mellow and easygoing any time of day

Refreshing flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Watermelon Z is ready whenever you are.
